decision: Stop homogeneous subspace notches, stop the tested spectral-slope lift family, stop further polynomial-bump scaling, and formulate a continuous axis/core extremal problem.
why: Homogeneous notch constraints only shrink the already-searched parent space and cannot improve primal feasibility.
The 21-frequency external lift improves the joint raw dual lower bound by only 1.12 percent and retains safe alpha 1.088115 above 1.
The best of 27 local geometries improves the joint raw dual lower bound by 3.87 percent but retains safe alpha 1.071761 above 1 and a near-null tail direction.
Dense audits show distant-peak migration while the target-near A1 charge remains dominant.
first_actions: Define a real-even compact-support Hilbert domain with the structural zeros G(0)=G(i/2)=0.
Derive reproducing kernels for real-axis evaluation, complex-core evaluation, derivatives, and the tail penalty.
Formulate the five-band supremum as a measure dual and state strong-duality hypotheses.
Solve a simplified one-band one-core-point extremal before restoring the full cover.
Compare v0.5 sparse measures with continuous KKT support and test Galerkin convergence.

success_gate.analytic: Produce a rigorous lower bound, separating inequality, or existence/duality theorem for a clearly specified continuous subproblem.
success_gate.constructive: Produce a Galerkin upper bound with explicit convergence or a posteriori error control indicating a value below 1.
success_gate.scope: Continuous extremal progress only; no RH inference without the inherited global gaps.

stop_rules: Do not resume unguided local-bump density scaling.
Do not accept a coarse-grid-only alpha below 1.
Do not infer continuous impossibility from finite-basis saturation.
Do not build large prime matrices before a continuous or certified finite gate has decision value.
Derive future external atoms from kernel residuals or extremal equations.
forbidden_inferences: The tested lift saturation proves all external dictionaries fail.
A finite dual obstruction proves or disproves RH.
A dual value below 1 proves primal feasibility.
A local extremal result closes unknown off-axis leakage or zero presence.
